idiom.note: raw pinned threads + one bounded SPSC ring per (worker, worker) pair; the master (actor 0) relays every child item round-robin to worker actor w (id cores + w) on thread w % cores, the master on thread 0 -- qb's placement; not an actor framework and not ranked as one

caveats: THIS IS NOT A FRAMEWORK. A work item is one ring message carrying the packed board, a result and a done one word each, and the search is the same shared kernel every framework runs: the floor for relaying a work-distribution search through one master

worker w is owned by thread w % cores and the master by thread 0, fixed before the window -- qb's placement exactly: with cores=2 the search is split the way the rotation splits it and never rebalanced, so this floor bounds the placing frameworks and NOT the pools
cores=1 is one thread with every actor's messages in its own ring -- the floor for single-threaded dispatch, still a real queue
wait=1 busy-polls the rings; wait=0 parks an idle worker on a condition variable
